Kobas API v3: REST, JSON, base api.kobas.co.uk/v3, OAuth2 client credentials (POST oauth.kobas.co.uk/access_token, token lasts 1 h), headers Bearer + x-kobas-company-id, pull only, no webhooks. Trifft: base api.trifft.io/v1, Bearer token. Deliverect: api.deliverect.com, OAuth2, channel scope.
